title: Jewellery E-Commerce — Product Requirements Document
execution_order: Phase A (API & Business Logic) → Phase B (Optimizations & Fixes) → Phase C (UI Implementations)

phases.name: API & Business Logic
phases.description: All backend APIs, database schema changes, services, validation, and core business logic. No UI work — purely server-side.

tasks.title: Categories Entity — Schema & API
tasks.description: Currently category is a free-text string on products, causing inconsistent naming. Create a proper categories table with hierarchy support and full CRUD API.

subtasks.title: Create categories table (id, name, slug, parent_id, image_url, sort_order, is_active, created_at, updated_at)
Add RLS policies and indexes for categories table
Create category Zod validators (categoryCreateSchema, categoryUpdateSchema)
Create category service (CRUD + hierarchy queries)
Create category API routes (GET list, GET by id, POST, PATCH, DELETE)
Migrate products.category from free-text to category_id FK reference

tasks.title: Customer Authentication API
tasks.description: Only admin auth exists. Build customer-facing auth: register, login, forgot password, email verification.

subtasks.title: Create POST /api/auth/register endpoint with email + password
Create customer JWT token flow (separate from admin-token cookie)
Create POST /api/auth/forgot-password and POST /api/auth/reset-password endpoints
Create email verification flow (generate token, send email, verify endpoint)
Create GET /api/customer/profile and PATCH /api/customer/profile endpoints for customer self-management
Add customer middleware to protect customer-only routes

tasks.title: Cart API & Business Logic
tasks.description: Core shopping cart functionality: add/remove items, quantity management, guest carts, and cart merging on login.

subtasks.title: Create carts and cart_items tables (support both guest and authenticated carts)
Create cart Zod validators
Create cart service (add item, update quantity, remove item, clear cart, get cart with product details)
Create cart API routes (GET, POST add, PATCH update quantity, DELETE item, DELETE clear)
Implement stock validation on add-to-cart (check available quantity)
Implement guest-to-user cart merge on login/register

tasks.title: Orders & Checkout API
tasks.description: Order creation from cart, order lifecycle management, and payment integration.

subtasks.title: Create orders and order_items tables with proper status enum (pending, confirmed, processing, shipped, delivered, cancelled, refunded)
Create addresses table for shipping/billing addresses
Create order Zod validators (checkout schema, status update schema)
Create order service (create from cart, get by id, list by user, update status, cancel)
Create checkout API route — validate stock, create order, decrement stock atomically (transaction)
Integrate payment gateway (Razorpay for INR) — create order, verify payment, webhook handler
Create admin order management API routes (list all, update status, get details)
Add Discord notifications for new orders and status changes

tasks.title: Wishlist API
tasks.description: Allow authenticated customers to save products to their wishlist.

subtasks.title: Create wishlists table (user_id, product_id, created_at)
Create wishlist service (add, remove, list, check if product is wishlisted)
Create wishlist API routes (GET list, POST toggle, DELETE remove)

tasks.title: Dashboard Stats Endpoint
tasks.description: admin/page.tsx fetches limit: 100 products & users to compute aggregate stats. Create a dedicated GET /api/admin/stats endpoint with aggregate SQL.

subtasks.title: Create stats-service.ts with aggregate SQL (total products, active, out of stock, inventory value, total users, total orders, revenue)
Create GET /api/admin/stats route handler

tasks.title: Search API (Full-Text)
tasks.description: Create a powerful search API endpoint for products using Supabase full-text search with filters.

subtasks.title: Add tsvector column and GIN index to products table for full-text search
Create GET /api/products/search endpoint with query, category, price range, material filters
Create admin search API (GET /api/admin/search) for products, users, and orders

tasks.title: Public Product API (Storefront)
tasks.description: Create public (no-auth) API routes for storefront product browsing — listing, detail, and featured products.

subtasks.title: Create GET /api/products (public list with pagination, sorting, filtering by category/material/price)
Create GET /api/products/[slug] (public detail with images, related products)
Create GET /api/products/featured (curated or auto-selected featured products)
Create GET /api/categories (public category list with product counts)

tasks.title: Audit Log Persistence
tasks.description: Discord webhooks are fire-and-forget. Add an audit_logs table to persist all admin actions in the database.

subtasks.title: Create audit_logs table schema (action, resource, resource_id, actor_id, actor_email, details jsonb, ip_address, timestamp)
Create audit log service (create entry, list with filters/pagination)
Update logAdminAction to write to database alongside Discord
Create GET /api/admin/audit-logs route with filters (actor, resource, date range)

tasks.title: AI Product Description Generator API
tasks.description: Server-side API to auto-generate product descriptions, SEO meta, and image alt text using an LLM.

subtasks.title: Create AI service wrapper for OpenAI/Gemini API (src/lib/ai.ts)
Create POST /api/admin/ai/generate-description endpoint (input: name, category, material → output: description, meta_description, tags)
Create POST /api/admin/ai/generate-alt-text endpoint (input: image_url → output: alt text)

tasks.title: AI Smart Categorization API
tasks.description: API to auto-suggest category or material based on product name using LLM zero-shot classification.

subtasks.title: Create POST /api/admin/ai/suggest-category endpoint (input: product name → output: suggested category, material, tags)
Create POST /api/admin/ai/auto-tag endpoint for occasion-based tagging (wedding, everyday, festive)

tasks.title: Visual Search & Image Analysis API
tasks.summary: Added analyzeImage function to AI service using Gemini vision to extract jewellery attributes (type, metal_color, gemstones, style, material, occasion) and suggested product fields from uploaded images. Created POST /api/admin/ai/analyze-image endpoint with Zod validation.
tasks.description: Use a vision model to extract jewellery attributes from uploaded images and return structured data.

subtasks.title: Create POST /api/admin/ai/analyze-image endpoint (input: image_url → output: type, metal_color, gemstones, style)
Map vision analysis output to product field suggestions

tasks.title: AI Chatbot Backend (RAG Pipeline)
tasks.summary: Built full RAG pipeline: pgvector migration with HNSW index and match_product_embeddings RPC, embeddings service using Gemini text-embedding-004, vector similarity search, chat service with conversation history and context-aware responses, POST /api/chat public endpoint, and POST /api/admin/ai/embeddings for batch/single embedding generation.
tasks.description: RAG pipeline over product data for a storefront chatbot: embeddings, vector search, and conversational API.

subtasks.title: Set up product embeddings pipeline (generate embeddings on product create/update)
Create vector search endpoint using Supabase pgvector
Create POST /api/chat endpoint with RAG-augmented responses

tasks.title: Smart Inventory Alerts Logic
tasks.summary: Built inventory alerts service with sales velocity analysis from order history, stock-out prediction (days until stockout), restock recommendations with urgency levels (critical/warning/low), and Discord notification for low-stock alerts. Created GET/POST /api/admin/inventory/alerts endpoints.
tasks.description: Backend logic to predict stock-outs and generate restock recommendations.

subtasks.title: Build stock-out prediction service based on sales velocity trends
Create scheduled job / cron for low-stock alerts to Discord
Create GET /api/admin/inventory/alerts endpoint

tasks.title: Dynamic Pricing Suggestions API
tasks.summary: Built pricing suggestions service analyzing product margins, category averages, and sales data. Generates compare_price suggestions for products without one, flags low-discount products, identifies underpriced items. Includes margin analysis and category pricing breakdown. Created GET /api/admin/pricing/suggestions endpoint.
tasks.description: Backend logic to analyze competitor pricing and suggest compare_price values.

subtasks.title: Build competitor pricing analysis with web scraping + LLM summary
Create GET /api/admin/pricing/suggestions endpoint

phases.name: Optimizations & Fixes
phases.description: Performance, security, accessibility, architecture improvements, and bug fixes. Applied after APIs are stable.

tasks.title: Rate Limiting on Auth Endpoints
tasks.description: Add rate limiting to /api/auth/login and /api/auth/register to prevent brute-force attacks.

subtasks.title: Implement in-memory rate limiter (Map with TTL) or Upstash Redis
Apply rate limiting middleware to auth endpoints and return 429 on threshold

tasks.title: CSRF Protection
tasks.description: Harden JWT-in-cookie auth against CSRF. Verify SameSite cookie attribute and consider adding a CSRF token.

subtasks.title: Verify and set SameSite=Strict or SameSite=Lax on admin-token and customer cookies
Consider adding CSRF token for non-GET API requests

tasks.title: Input Sanitization & CSP Headers
tasks.description: Sanitize the description field for XSS prevention and add Content-Security-Policy headers.

subtasks.title: Sanitize product description field for XSS if rendered as rich text
Add Content-Security-Policy headers in next.config.ts

tasks.title: Environment Variable Validation
tasks.description: Validate all required env vars at build time using Zod. Fail fast with clear messages if any are missing.

subtasks.title: Create src/lib/env.ts with Zod schema for all required environment variables
Import env validation in next.config.ts for build-time checking

tasks.title: Error Handling Standardization
tasks.description: Create a shared AppError class with error codes and standardize API error responses.

subtasks.title: Create shared AppError class with error codes (NOT_FOUND, UNAUTHORIZED, VALIDATION_ERROR, etc.)
Create API error response helper that maps AppError to consistent JSON { error, code, details }
Refactor all API routes to use AppError and standardized responses

tasks.title: Image Optimization Config
tasks.description: Configure next/image with Cloudinary loader for automatic format conversion (WebP/AVIF), resizing, and lazy loading.

subtasks.title: Set image.remotePatterns in next.config.ts for Cloudinary domains
Configure next-cloudinary CldImage component with sizes and placeholder blur

tasks.title: API Response Caching
tasks.description: Add Cache-Control headers for public endpoints and use Next.js caching with on-demand revalidation.

subtasks.title: Add Cache-Control headers for public product listing and category endpoints
Implement unstable_cache or fetch cache for frequently-hit product data
Implement revalidateTag for on-demand cache invalidation on product/category update

tasks.title: Bundle Size Optimization
tasks.description: Audit unused imports, consolidate UI libraries, and lazy-load heavy admin components.

subtasks.title: Audit and remove duplicate UI libraries (@base-ui/react vs radix-ui — pick one)
Use next/dynamic for heavy admin-only components (product form, image uploader)

tasks.title: Database Migrations Strategy
tasks.description: Adopt Supabase CLI migrations or dbmate for versioned, repeatable migrations.

subtasks.title: Evaluate and adopt Supabase CLI migrations or dbmate
Convert existing schema.sql into versioned migration files

tasks.title: Testing Strategy Setup
tasks.description: No test framework exists. Set up Vitest for unit tests, Playwright for E2E, and MSW for API mocking.

subtasks.title: Install and configure Vitest for unit tests
Write unit tests for validators, utils, and services
Install and configure Playwright for E2E tests
Write E2E tests for login flow, product CRUD, and user CRUD
Set up MSW (Mock Service Worker) for component-level API mocking

tasks.title: Form Accessibility Fixes
tasks.description: Ensure all inputs have associated labels, aria-describedby for error messages, and visible focus rings.

subtasks.title: Audit and add associated label elements to all inputs using shadcn FormLabel
Add aria-describedby linking inputs to their error messages
Verify visible focus rings across all interactive elements

tasks.title: Color Contrast Audit
tasks.description: Verify muted-foreground text meets WCAG AA (4.5:1) and ensure destructive states have sufficient contrast.

subtasks.title: Audit OKLCH 0.551 muted-foreground on white background for WCAG AA compliance
Verify destructive state contrast in both light and dark modes

phases.name: UI Implementations
phases.description: All frontend UI work: storefront pages, admin UI enhancements, charts, animations, and visual polish. Built on top of stable APIs from Phase A and optimizations from Phase B.

tasks.title: Activate TanStack Query for Client-Side Data Fetching
tasks.description: Migrate all client-side data fetching to TanStack React Query with query keys, caching, and optimistic updates.

subtasks.title: Set up QueryClient provider and configure defaults (staleTime, gcTime, retry)
Create query hooks for products, users, categories, orders (useProducts, useUsers, etc.)
Create mutation hooks with optimistic updates for all CRUD operations

tasks.title: Expand Zustand Stores
tasks.description: Expand Zustand beyond auth-store to cart, wishlist, and UI state management.

subtasks.title: Create cart-store.ts (items, add, remove, update quantity, clear, total)
Create wishlist-store.ts (items, toggle, check)
Create ui-store.ts (sidebar state, filter state, search state)

tasks.title: Customer Storefront — Homepage
tasks.summary: Built storefront homepage with (storefront) route group, hero section with gradient overlay and CTA, featured products Framer Motion carousel, category grid with glassmorphism cards, sticky navbar with search/cart/user menu, and 3-column footer. SSR via storefront-service.ts for SEO.
tasks.description: Build the customer-facing homepage with hero, featured products, and category grid.

subtasks.title: Hero section with lifestyle image, amber-gold gradient overlay, and CTA
Featured / trending products carousel powered by Framer Motion
Category grid with hover zoom and glassmorphism cards
Footer with store info, links, and social media
Storefront navbar with logo, search, cart icon (with count badge), and user menu

tasks.title: Customer Storefront — Product Listing Page
tasks.summary: Built product listing page at /products with nuqs URL-state filters (category, material, price range), sort controls (newest/price/name), responsive product grid with stagger animations, pagination with ellipsis, quick-view modal with add-to-cart, and mobile Sheet filter sidebar.
tasks.description: Product catalog page with filters, sorting, pagination, and grid/list view toggle.

subtasks.title: Product grid with cards (image, name, price, compare price, wishlist button)
Filter sidebar (category, material, price range, in-stock only)
Sort controls (price low/high, newest, name A-Z)
Pagination with URL query params (nuqs)
Quick-view modal for browsing without leaving the listing page

tasks.title: Customer Storefront — Product Detail Page
tasks.summary: Built product detail page at /products/[slug] with SSR via getProductBySlug, cursor-tracking zoom-on-hover image gallery with thumbnail strip, product info section (name, price, discount badge, description, material, weight, stock), quantity selector with stock clamping and add-to-cart, breadcrumbs nav, related products grid, and SEO metadata with generateMetadata.
tasks.description: Individual product page with image gallery, details, reviews, and add-to-cart.

subtasks.title: Image gallery with zoom-on-hover and thumbnail navigation
Product info section (name, price, compare price, description, material, weight, stock status)
Add to cart button with quantity selector and stock validation
Breadcrumbs navigation
Related products section

tasks.title: Customer Storefront — Cart & Checkout Pages
tasks.description: Shopping cart page and multi-step checkout flow with payment.

subtasks.title: Cart page with item list, quantity controls, remove button, and order summary
Checkout step 1: Shipping address form
Checkout step 2: Order review and payment
Order confirmation page with order details and tracking

tasks.title: Customer Auth Pages
tasks.summary: Built customer auth pages: signin with email/password and CSRF, register with email verification flow, forgot-password and reset-password with token validation, profile page with edit mode and recent orders, orders listing with pagination, and logout handler. Updated navbar with My Account link and fixed /login routes to /signin.
tasks.description: Login, register, forgot password, and profile pages for customers.

subtasks.title: Customer login page
Customer registration page
Forgot password page and reset password page
Customer profile page (edit name, phone, password, view order history)

tasks.title: Admin Dashboard — Richer Analytics UI
tasks.summary: Refactored dashboard to client-side data fetching via React Query with 60s auto-refresh. Added shadcn/recharts: revenue trend area chart (30 days), order status horizontal bar chart, top-selling products bar chart. Integrated inventory alerts widget consuming GET /api/admin/inventory/alerts. Added recent orders timeline with status badges. Extended stats service with revenue_trend, top_products, and recent_orders data. Dashboard now actively uses inventory alerts and pricing services built in Phase A.
tasks.description: Refactor dashboard page to use stats API and add charts, trends, and real-time updates.

subtasks.title: Refactor admin dashboard page to use GET /api/admin/stats endpoint
Revenue trend chart (daily/weekly/monthly) using Recharts or shadcn charts
Top-selling products chart
Stock level distribution pie/donut chart
Recent orders timeline
Real-time stat updates using TanStack Query refetchInterval

Order detail page shows items table with product images, price breakdown, status timeline, customer info, shipping address, and status update with ConfirmDialog. Uses existing useGetOrders, useGetOrder, useUpdateOrderStatus hooks. Added Orders to admin sidebar menu.

Category create/edit form with parent selector and image upload

tasks.description: Admin page to view and filter persisted audit logs.

subtasks.title: Audit log list page with filters (actor, resource, date range) and pagination
